spec.accept_rule: argmax in classes 0..3 and p[argmax] >= tau; otherwise abstain to explorer
spec.selection_rule: tau* = smallest grid tau with per-grid(10,15) probe precision>=0.90 AND adjacent recall>=0.90; if none, smallest tau with recall>=0.90 on both grids maximizing total precision (tie -> smaller tau); CueMean curve reference only
spec.note: 规范在查看任何tau曲线之前落盘；CueMean仅作参考不参与选择
